blocks.explanation:
\(\sqrt{x}\) ke \(\sin\) ke andar hone ki wajah se pehle \(t = \sqrt{x}\) rakhte hain; \(x = t^2\) aur \(dx = 2t\,dt\).
Integral \(2\int t^2\sin t\,dt\) ban jata hai: algebraic \(\times\) trigonometric.
\(t^2\) ko first function banayenge. \(t^2\) do dafa differentiate ho kar khatam hota hai, is liye parts do dafa lagega.
Plan: substitution, do dafa parts, wapas \(x\), aur sign ka khaas khayal.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \sqrt{x}\sin\sqrt{x}\,dx\), \(x > 0\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: \(t = \sqrt{x}\), \(dx = 2t\,dt\); phir \(2\int t^2\sin t\,dt\) par do dafa parts.

Substitution
\[x = t^2,\ dx = 2t\,dt\]
\[\int t\sin t\cdot 2t\,dt = 2\int t^2\sin t\,dt\]
Kyun: \(\sqrt{x} = t\) aur \(dx = 2t\,dt\); \(t \cdot 2t = 2t^2\).

Pehli dafa parts
\[\int t^2\sin t\,dt = -t^2\cos t + \int 2t\cos t\,dt\]
Kyun: \(t^2\) first, \(\sin t\) second: \(t^2(-\cos t) - \int (-\cos t)(2t)\,dt\). Do minus se plus.
Dhyan dein: \(\int \sin t\,dt = -\cos t\) ka minus yahan sab se zyada bhoola jata hai.

Doosri dafa parts
\[\int 2t\cos t\,dt = 2t\sin t - \int 2\sin t\,dt\]
\[= 2t\sin t + 2\cos t\]
Kyun: ab \(2t\) first aur \(\cos t\) second: \(2t\sin t - \int 2\sin t\,dt = 2t\sin t + 2\cos t\).

Jor kar 2 se zarb
\[2\int t^2\sin t\,dt = -2t^2\cos t + 4t\sin t + 4\cos t + c\]
\[= -2x\cos\sqrt{x} + 4\sqrt{x}\sin\sqrt{x} + 4\cos\sqrt{x} + c\]
Kyun: pehle teen terms ko 2 se zarb diya, phir \(t = \sqrt{x}\) aur \(t^2 = x\) wapas rakhe.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dt}(-2t^2\cos t + 4t\sin t + 4\cos t)\]
\[= -4t\cos t + 2t^2\sin t + 4\sin t + 4t\cos t - 4\sin t\]
\[= 2t^2\sin t\]
Kyun: \(t\) ke lihaz se differentiate kiya; sab cancel ho kar \(2t^2\sin t\) bacha, jo step 1 ka integrand hai. Matlab jawab sahi.
